rows.label: tlk70000032_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Since meeting Seiryuu-sama, the Divine
Beasts have come to feel much closer
to me.

rows.label: tlk70000032_04_msg0002
rows.name:
That's why I think I understand the
importance of guarding this place
better than any other soldier.

rows.label: tlk70000032_04_msg0004
rows.name:
They say it illustrates the history
of humans and Divine Beasts.

rows.label: tlk70000032_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Nobody knows when it was made, but
we know whoever made it must have
respected Divine Beasts as we do.

rows.label: tlk70000032_04_msg0006
rows.name:
It makes me feel I must carry on those
thoughts and that history myself.

rows.label: tlk70000032_04_msg0007
rows.name:
So if enemies attack this place again,
I'll protect it to the very end!
